## Activity

During November 2023, East City Eye Clinic recorded 219 captures. Activity was reviewed as part of the routine site operations report. The recorded total provides the basis for monitoring the volume of imaging undertaken during the month. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave. No further operational variation is noted in the available report information.

## Image quality

Image quality was assessed for the captures completed during the reporting period. Of the 219 captures, 7 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 3.2 per cent. The ungradable cases should be considered when reviewing the overall usefulness of the images submitted for grading. The report records this result without identifying an additional cause or pattern.

## Grading

A total of 55 results were graded referable. The median grading lag was 3 days. This measure should be read alongside the activity and image-quality results. Overall, the report records the monthly capture volume, the number and rate of ungradable images, the referable grading result, and the median lag for East City Eye Clinic during November 2023.
